context: Evaluates the read-first, duplicate-check, schema-validated append workflow for a genuinely new, well-formed rule request.

checklist.name: Reads existing rules first
checklist.description: The existing rules file is read and checked for a duplicate directive before any append happens

checklist.name: Three-part entry structure
checklist.description: The new entry includes a Rule title, a Directive in ALWAYS/NEVER phrasing, and a Rationale

checklist.name: Uses the generate/validate tooling
checklist.description: The entry is produced via the validation script's generate mode and checked with its validate mode rather than hand-typed and eyeballed

checklist.name: Directive is actionable
checklist.description: The directive is a precise, checkable ALWAYS/NEVER statement rather than a vague paraphrase

checklist.name: User informed
checklist.description: The user is told the rule was added, only after validation actually passed
